crossRefs.note: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders…
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the…
Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.
David went up from there, and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Engedi
people.line: Oasis in Judah; refuge for David; Chedorlaomer's victory

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).
translations.bsb: Then some men came and told Jehoshaphat, “A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from beyond the Sea; they are already in Hazazon-tamar” (that is, En-gedi).
translations.kjv: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.
translations.asv: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea from Syria; and, behold, they are in Hazazon-tamar (the same is En-gedi).
